description: parity-cc-tools' log events (log-record.v1, parity-contracts CONVENTIONS "Logging"), from the 0.16.0 starter, owned here. Nothing is call-scoped: the tool touches no call. Every record of an operator action carries op_id (and saga_id once there is one), so `contract-check --flow <op_id>` follows it across parity-cc-tools and parity-rs. Operators appear as attrs.actor_sub only, never a name or an address. The common events (service.*, config.*, log.dropped, dependency.*) are logging/events.common.v1.json's.

http.request.description: One HTTP request served on the UI port: op is the method and the matched route (never the raw path), attrs.status; outcome ok (< 400), refused (4xx), error (5xx, at warn).

auth.login_succeeded.description: An operator signed in to the ops realm (attrs.actor_sub; attrs.step_up true for a fresh login asked by a high-risk action).

auth.login_refused.description: A sign-in, a token or a session was refused (attrs.reason: wrong_issuer, wrong_audience, expired, no_ops_role, no_otp, no_subject, session_revoked, login_failed).

auth.step_up_required.description: A high-risk action needs a fresh login (auth_time older than attrs.max_age_s): the operator is sent to the ops realm with max_age, and the action's confirmation page resumes after.

auth.logged_out.description: An operator's sessions ended: a logout here (cause http:logout) or the ops realm's back-channel logout (cause http:backchannel-logout; attrs.sessions).

action.requested.description: An operator confirmed an action; its audit row was written before it is sent (attrs.action, attrs.actor_sub, attrs.risk).

action.answered.description: The backend answered an action (outcome ok, or refused with error.code and attrs.rule).

action.not_confirmed.description: No answer in time (or the request couldn't be sent: attrs.sent false): the page follows the saga's events by saga_id; retry resends the same ids.

action.refused.description: An action was refused before anything was sent or written (attrs.reason: typed_confirmation, reason_length, force_required, forbidden, stale_form).

action.outcome.description: The action's saga ended (attrs.saga_outcome); written once, by the pod whose operation_outcome insert won.

audit.write_failed.description: An audit row (phase requested) could not be written: nothing was sent (fail closed).

audit.answer_write_failed.description: The answered row or the outcome row could not be written (the action already ran): the requested row stays and shows as not confirmed (attrs.phase).

audit.partitions_created.description: Monthly audit partitions were created ahead (attrs.created).

audit.partitions_failed.description: The audit partitions can't be checked or created (error.kind): readiness fails; a month without a partition stops every action (fail closed).

audit.reconciled.description: At start, answered actions without an outcome were looked up again (attrs.checked, attrs.written).

rs.answered.description: parity-rs answered a read (request_id: the command id; op: the command; outcome; duration_ms; zone).

rs.read_failed.description: A read from parity-rs failed or wasn't answered in time (error.code, op); at error, a request this tool built failed its schema and was not sent (a bug).

rs.wrong_zone_followed.description: parity-rs answered wrong_zone: the request was sent once more to the owner zone (zone: the first zone, attrs.owner_zone).

rs.reader_assigned.description: A reader (answers or a zone's events) reads attrs.partitions partitions of attrs.topic from the latest offset.

rs.reader_failed.description: A reader failed (error.kind); it starts again after a backoff.

rs.record_unreadable.description: An answer or an event that isn't usable JSON was skipped (attrs.topic, attrs.partition, attrs.offset).

rs.saga_resynced.description: A saga's events had a gap (attrs.seen_seq, attrs.event_seq) or the page reconnected: its state was read again with get_saga.

service_op.state_changed.description: A service-control saga moved (from_state, to_state; cause: the observed fact or the operator action; attrs.service_name, attrs.driver, attrs.instance).

service_op.reapplied.description: A holding service-control saga found its setting changed behind its back (an opensips restart, a chart upgrade) and set it again (attrs.what).

service_op.finished.description: A service-control saga ended (attrs.saga_outcome: done, released, cancelled, failed, aborted).

health.collected.description: A health snapshot was taken (attrs.instances, attrs.services, duration_ms).

health.probe_failed.description: A health probe failed (attrs.service_name, attrs.probe, error.kind or attrs.status).

k8s.call_failed.description: A Kubernetes API call failed (op: the call; error.code: the HTTP status class or kind).

mi.call_failed.description: An opensips management call failed (op: the MI method; error.kind or attrs.status).

lifecycle.stale_file_removed.description: A healthy or drained file left by an earlier run was removed at the start (attrs.file).

lifecycle.file_failed.description: The healthy or drained file couldn't be written or removed (attrs.file, error.kind); the healthy file is tried again (attrs.retry_ms).

readiness.gate_started.description: The application started; the readiness gate waits for its checks (attrs.checks) before writing the healthy file.

readiness.passed.description: Every readiness check passes again (service.not_ready names the failing ones).

signal.received.description: SIGTERM or SIGINT (attrs.signal): the first drains (cause signal:<name>), a second exits at once (warn, attrs.exit_code).

signal.handlers_missing.description: The signal handlers couldn't be installed: Spring's shutdown hook still drains, the exit codes differ.

drain.completed.description: Every drainable finished in time (the SSE streams closed, the requests in flight done): the drained file is written (attrs.file, duration_ms).

drain.timed_out.description: The drain didn't finish within the drain timeout (attrs.waiting_for): no drained file, exit 1.

drain.failed.description: Closing the application failed during the drain: exit 1.

log.external.description: A record of a library the tool uses (Spring, Tomcat, Hikari, Kafka, Flyway): attrs.logger names it, its text is msg.
